title: Topic 21
japanese_text: 芸能人の不倫報道に対して、ＳＮＳ上で<u>モラル</u>に<u>欠ける</u><u>言動</u>を繰り返す人が後を絶たない。私たちは<u>当事者</u>ではなく<u>第三者</u>なのだから、いちいち口出しをするのは不適切だ。
english_translation: In response to reports of celebrity infidelity, there seems to be no end to people on social media just repeating words and deeds lacking in any morals. It's not appropriate for us to comment on every single matter, because we are third parties, not the ones involved.
